pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin light-colored pathways with frequent multi-node junctions. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains consistent across the visible lateral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane silhouette presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern along the upper neck profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white high-contrast region visible at the ventral-proximal junction of the forelimb and chest.
